description:
Join a premier home health agency in Billings, MT, as a Registered Nurse (RN). We are seeking dedicated and compassionate RNs for both full-time and part-time opportunities, offering a highly competitive annual salary range of $115,000 - $125,000. This role provides the flexibility to manage your schedule while delivering essential care in a home-based setting.
As a Home Health RN, you will provide comprehensive nursing care to patients in their homes, focusing on health assessment, medication management, wound care, and patient education. You will play a crucial role in promoting patient independence and well-being within the comfort of their own environment, requiring travel within the Billings area.
If you are an experienced RN looking for a rewarding role with excellent compensation and work-life balance, we encourage you to apply. This is an urgent need to support our growing patient community.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Montana or compact state eligibility
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in home health or a related clinical setting
Excellent clinical assessment, communication, and documentation skills
Ability to travel locally to patient homes
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $115,000 - $125,000, based on experience and contract type (Full-time or Part-time).
